summary: Queries the game command dispatch interface global dword_7CD8C0 for the current selection identifier through its vtable (method at offset +28, argument 22). If the returned object is non-null, reads a selection value from it and compares it against the cached value at this+0xE8 (this[58]); on a difference, updates the cache and invokes a this vtable notification callback (offset +44, argument 1). Always returns 0.

operations.description: Dispatch a query through the command interface global dword_7CD8C0: dereference its vtable pointer and call the thiscall method at vtable offset +28 (index 7) with argument 22 to obtain the current selection object.
If the dispatch query returned a null object (v2 == 0), take the early return-0 path and skip the update entirely.

Read the reported selection identifier from the dispatch result object. Raw source reads result+372 (0x174); packet field evidence labels the result-object read field at offset 0x2C. Store into a temporary for comparison.
Compare the reported selection identifier against the cached value stored at this+0xE8 (this[58]); if equal, skip the cache update and the notification callback.
Cache the reported selection identifier into this+0xE8 (this[58]), replacing the previous cached value.
Load the vtable pointer from this+0x0 (*this) and invoke the thiscall method at vtable offset +44 (0x2C, index 11) with (this, 1) as the change notification callback.
Return 0 from the method on every path.
